0022600175.text: The Bucks (1-6) enter this, their eighth game of the season, on a three-game losing streak, sitting 14th in the East and 0-3 on the road, while the Celtics (5-2) are third in the East and 4-0 at home. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Bucks lost their 2025-26 series 1-3, including a 133-101 loss in Milwaukee on April 3, 2026. Boston will be without Devin Carter (illness) and Paul George (rest), both listed as out.
